description: Three-Tier Electoral Source Trust Registry used by the Election Intelligence Agent to separate source authority from raw retrieval.

TIER_1_OFFICIAL.label: Tier 1 — Statutory & Electoral Authority
TIER_1_OFFICIAL.verification_rule: Primary authoritative record for electoral dates, legal procedures, voter eligibility, and official announcements.

sources.name: Official Gazette of the Federal Republic of Nigeria (Electoral Act)

TIER_2_ACCREDITED_OBSERVER.label: Tier 2 — Accredited Election Observers & Fact-Checking Coalitions
TIER_2_ACCREDITED_OBSERVER.verification_rule: High credibility for field observation, parallel vote tabulation (PVT) methodology, logistics monitoring, and forensic fact-checking. Must be cross-referenced with Tier 1 for statutory rules.

TIER_3_VERIFIED_MEDIA.label: Tier 3 — Accredited Public-Interest News Organizations
TIER_3_VERIFIED_MEDIA.verification_rule: Credible journalistic reporting with editorial standards. Claims regarding electoral law or schedule changes require corroboration from Tier 1 or Tier 2 sources.

untrusted_patterns.reason: Unattributed chain messages and viral audio notes lack verifiable provenance.
Known clickbait domain publishing fabricated tribunal rulings and fake postponement notices.
